no-restricted-globals.name: name
no-restricted-globals.message: window.name is a string and reads as an accidental global; use a local variable.

no-restricted-globals.name: event
no-restricted-globals.message: window.event is deprecated; take the handler argument.

no-restricted-globals.name: status
no-restricted-globals.message: window.status is a browser global; use a local variable.

no-restricted-globals.name: top
no-restricted-globals.message: window.top is the frame; do not shadow it.

no-restricted-globals.name: self
no-restricted-globals.message: window.self is the frame; do not shadow it.
